value.rationale: A single detector may fail in sensing networks, giving the RED:IC invariant independent operational motivation. The exact solution space separates into geometrically identifiable frozen quadrangles and mobile omitted two-edge matchings; sharp two-change global connectivity and full distance profiles supply nontrivial reconfiguration information beyond the minimum code cardinality. The theorem completely resolves a natural finite problem on the canonical Fano incidence network.
